description: Analyze origin web access logs (Nginx/Apache/IIS) to detect CC attacks, proxy-pool distributed bots, scanning probes, login brute force, abnormal crawlers, QPS/bandwidth/status-code surges, and slow resource consumption, then produce an actionable security report with mitigation advice. Read-only; no credentials required. Triggers: "CC attack", "HTTP flood", "proxy pool bot", "login brute force", "web access log analysis", "access log security analysis", "abnormal crawler", "QPS surge", "bandwidth surge", "4xx/5xx surge", "site being attacked", "scanning probe", "API abuse", "slow request analysis".
